input: Day of week and activities
outcome: Sunday (Sun): first hour good for love ventures; good for new clothes, building, travel east; child born is fortunate. Monday: good for all work, marriage, naming, school start, house building, bath for health; travel south/west good; bad for illness; child born is good. Tuesday: mixed; house change/buy/sell ok, new clothes bad; travel east/south ok; child hot-tempered. Wednesday: new clothes, entering house, school, ploughing good; travel east/west ok; child fond of learning. Thursday: good for new clothes, meetings, trade, marriage, house change; best for travel; child fortunate. Friday: very auspicious for trade, building, marriage, school start; travel after 3 pm; success in any work begun. Saturday: most inauspicious: no new clothes, new work or travel; child often sickly
strength_note: Day-suitability section
source: Asli Prachin Lal Kitab (Hindi, archive.org asli-prachin-lal-kitab), Ketu principles, deity worship, sign shanti, body nishaniyan, days (offset 454300-479831 end)
